Hidden costs before buying your first home

Budgeting only for the sale price can leave a first-time buyer short on cash. Transfer tax, brokerage fees, registration, loan costs, and repairs after move-in all need their own line in the budget. After estimating each cost, keep 10% of your available cash untouched as a buffer. Once the deposit is paid, your options narrow quickly.
